source: BS 6399-1:1996 5.1-5.2: reduction of the imposed loads on columns, walls and foundations by the number of floors carried (Table 2), and of beams by the area supported (Table 3 / 5.1)

sources.floorCount.rows: BS 6399-1:1996 Table 2: reduction by the number of floors (including the roof) carried: 1 0 %, 2 10 %, 3 20 %, 4 30 %, 5-10 40 %, over 10 50 %
sources.floorCount.beamArea: BS 6399-1:1996 5.1 / Table 3: a beam supporting more than 50 m² at one level, 5 % for each 50 m² beyond, at most 25 %
sources.heavyLive: BS 6399-1:1996 5.1: no reduction for loads due to storage, plant and machinery (SAEngine: the uses in notReduced and floors over 5.0 kN/m²)
sources.kll: Not a BS 6399 value: the floor-count rule has no live load element factor (all 1)
